en: The postcard features a sepia-toned image of a busy waterfront scene with small boats docked in the foreground. Behind the harbor, there is an ornate building and a very tall monument with a statue on top. People are visible walking along the promenade and steps. The monument and buildings evoke a historic European city. There is printed text at the top right, and the card’s edges show signs of aging.
